title: Cassie & Jérémy
description: Jeremy is more and more absent... What is he hiding?

questions.question: First, can you check if he met a girl 3 days ago, on July 22? If yes, tell me who please.
I knew it... Do you see a slightly suspicious chat between Jérémy and Léa? If yes, tell me which app they're using.
questions.hint: A messaging app, there's a conversation with Léa.

questions.question: Okay, this is getting out of hand… Can you dig through their chats and tell me what they're hiding?
Thanks… you're the best for doing this. Find that photo please. If he deleted it there must be a code somewhere, look carefully and tell me.
questions.hint: The code is Jérémy's birth date.

questions.question: I need to understand who Léa really is to him. While digging, can you tell me what her job is? In the photo, there should be clues that can help you figure it out.
questions.hint: Now that you have access to deleted photos, look at the image details to find clues about Léa, like an email. Check his Gmail if there's any exchange with that email, it could help.

questions.question: Deep down, what I really want to know... is what he's hiding from me. A ring secretly ordered from a jeweler... what is he planning behind my back?
questions.hint: Nothing more to search, you already have all the clues to answer this question. Why would Jérémy buy a ring from a jeweler in secret?

questions.question: WHAT??? And I thought I was being cheated on... I'm so embarrassed now. Do you know if he already paid for the ring? If yes, tell me the brand please...
questions.hint: Look in bank transactions, you'll find the ring reference. Then you can compare with the rings presented by Léa in the emails.

questions.question: I'm way too curious... but can you tell me its color please?
I need to know how far this went… Do you know what message he wants engraved on the ring?
answer: for the rest of our lives
questions.hint: Check if he sent an email to get the ring engraved.

questions.question: He told me he wouldn't be around on July 30. Can you check his calendar or messages and tell me who he's meeting that day?
And this Hugo, what exactly does he do for a living?
questions.hint: Check if Hugo is in his contacts, you should find his job in the contact details.

questions.question: Oh wow, I’m really excited now... Could you find the city where he plans to propose?
questions.hint: On Google Maps, there should be a saved address mentioning a marriage proposal.

questions.question: Okay, and in Nice, where exactly is he planning it? What type of place did he pick?
I need to know if I'm really the last to find out… Do you see anything showing he talked to my dad? If yes, how did they get in touch?
Whoa! Incredible... Thanks. And what about my mom? Did he talk to her too? If yes, when please?

textSuccess: Wow thanks! So Léa is the jeweler, not a mistress... He's preparing all this to propose to me in Nice. I can't wait to say yes!

onboardingContent.text:
Hi... A friend told me to reach out because you're great at stalking.
I need you.

I've been with Jeremy for 4 years now. We've lived together for 2.
We've always had a super transparent relationship, that's what made us strong.

But for a few weeks, he's always on his phone.
He flips it over when I walk by, he steps out to take calls.
Last week, I saw him deleting messages. Why would he do that?

Yesterday morning, while he was in the shower, I grabbed his phone.
I copied everything to my Mac before he came out.
Here you go, you have access to everything now. Tell me what he's hiding.

notes.title: Carbonara recipe
notes.content:
🍝 PASTA CARBONARA (for 2)

Ingredients:
- 200g pasta (spaghetti)
- 150g smoked bacon
- 2 egg yolks
- 50g grated parmesan
- Black pepper
- Salt

Preparation:
1. Cook pasta al dente
2. Fry bacon without fat
3. Mix yolks + parmesan in a bowl
4. Drain pasta (keep some water)
5. Mix pasta + bacon off heat
6. Add egg-parmesan mixture
7. Stir quickly, add cooking water if needed
8. Pepper generously

Tip: Don't put back on heat after adding eggs!

notes.title: Grandma's gardening tips
notes.content:
🌱 GRANDMA'S GARDENING TIPS

Tomatoes:
- Plant mid-May after Ice Saints
- Water in the morning at the base (not leaves)
- Remove suckers regularly

Rose bushes:
- Prune in March (tulip shape)
- Special rose fertilizer in spring
- Treat preventively against aphids

Lawn:
- Mow regularly (never more than 1/3)
- Water in the evening in summer
- Scarify in spring

Herbs:
- Basil: sun + regular watering
- Rosemary: little water, full sun
- Parsley: partial shade
- Mint: careful invasive!

Note: Ask Grandma for plants for the balcony

What should I watch out for when buying a used car?

Here's a complete guide to buying a used car safely:

📋 BEFORE THE VISIT
- Check history via license plate (free vehicle history report)
- Compare prices on multiple sites
- Prefer sellers with complete history
- Be wary if price is too low

🔍 DOCUMENTS TO CHECK
- Registration (matches the seller)
- Technical inspection less than 6 months old
- Complete maintenance booklet
- Invoices for major repairs
- Certificate of no outstanding loans

🚗 VISUAL INSPECTION
- Body condition (rust, impacts)
- Check that panels are aligned
- Look under the hood (oil leaks)
- Tire condition (uniform wear)
- Interior (seats, dashboard)
- Mileage consistent with age

🔧 TEST DRIVE
- Cold start
- Test all equipment (AC, windows, radio)
- Listen for suspicious noises
- Test brakes
- Check steering
- Exhaust smoke

⚠️ RED FLAGS
- Rushed or evasive seller
- Refusal of test drive or inspection
- Odometer tampering
- Incomplete history
- Price negotiable too easily

💡 FINAL TIPS
- Bring a mechanic if possible
- Get an independent inspection at a garage
- Negotiate based on defects found
- Put everything in writing
